page.notes: The scan is of a page of a book by Constantini Magni's list of citations (Q. I.). The first and last lines are cut at the margins of the scan; the text ends with the fragment "Magi-", which continues on the next page. The "Cl." before Professorum is printed in a script form and is read as Cl. The text "Tareum" is read as printed; "Antapologiam" is read as printed. The digitiser's "Digitized by Google" line at the foot is left out.
